verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API with endpoints such as POST /v1/document_sets and publishes an llms.txt docs index, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probes for OpenAPI and Swagger paths on handbooks.clerky.com all returned 404, and per-form json_schema payloads and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
